summary: Two missing snowmobilers in the Wild Mountain area near the northwest boundary of Dinosaur National Monument; located March 21 by helicopter surveillance — a 58-year-old Deer Trail man was found deceased and a 65-year-old Thornton man was found alive and hospitalized
location: Wild Mountain area, Dinosaur National Monument (near Utah/Colorado border)
responding_agency: Moffat County Sheriff's Office; Moffat County Search and Rescue; Dinosaur National Monument rangers; Uintah County Sheriff's Office; Uintah County Search and Rescue; Utah Department of Natural Resources; Colorado Division of Fire Prevention and Control; Classic Air Medical; Utah Department of Public Safety
notes: SAR request received from MCSO Thursday March 19, 2020; subjects located Saturday March 21 via helo surveillance inside Dinosaur NM; run-334 merged National Park Traveler corroborating account (same Wild Mountain snowmobiler incident, confirmed March-2020 dates) | run-581 merged Gephardt Daily Uintah County SAR account: confirms multi-agency response incl. Uintah County SAR, Utah DPS/Classic Air helicopters; notes same pair was rescued on Wild Mountain (Utah side, Feb-29-2020) — prior Utah-side rescue not inserted (out of scope)
